name: Ardell The Torrent
bio: The custodian of Bright River, Ardell is on the forefront of the fight against Ulgorim's Horde. With a mere flick of his hand, he can transform the river from a gentle burble to a raging torrent, sweeping away all in its path. Goblins have now learned that going for a swim in Bright River may quickly lead to a watery fate.
